visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Count Is One Too Small
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The sorted array has 4 unique values (1 2 3 4), but the program reports 3 and prints only 1 2 3.

solution.explanation: write is the index where the next unique value would go, which is also the number of unique values written so far. Returning write - 1 drops the last unique element.
